scripts.install:all: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client start"
scripts.test: npm --prefix server test && npm --prefix client test -- --watch=false
scripts.deploy: node scripts/build-cloudflare.mjs && wrangler d1 migrations apply concursero-angular --remote && wrangler deploy
